I managed to get two bags of the government-subsidized NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer this year, so I will put one bag on this millet plot because the soil is very poor and millet needs it. I also have some cow manure from my animals that I will spread before planting since it helps the soil hold water. I am using my own saved millet seed from last season because the hybrid seed is too expensive, and I will weed by hand with my wife and children—we cannot afford to hire anyone for such a small plot, and there is no river nearby for irrigation.
